paragraphs.text: Homunculus ( Latin: "little person") is a creature type used for cards that depict a species of artificially made, but sentient and living, miniature humans .
These creatures are often used for menial or dangerous tasks. Many homunculi just have one cyclopic eye ( Oculus , Riddlekeeper ).
Homunculi primarily appear in blue and occasionally in white . Borborygmos and Fblthp is the only red homunculus and, along with Aeromunculus , one of only 2 green homunculi.

Regardless of their plane of origin, most named homunculi feature consonant-heavy, vowel-light names. Mark Rosewater has summarized the naming process as "You just come up with a fun name and then remove all the vowels."

The first creature to bear the type was Bonded Fetch in Future Sight , though the Sneaky Homunculus from Nemesis and the Hazy Homunculus from Prophecy were later issued errata to become Homunculi in addition to their Illusion type.

Blue-skinned homunculi live on Esper , one of the five Shards of Alara . Like all living things on the plane, they are artifact creatures , and in Esper's case, they are magically constructed. Homunculi are sentient and self-willed, but incapable of defying the demands of their creators. They are used for a myriad of purposes, but most often function as clerks, scribes, and couriers, and as decorative additions to mages' retinues. The mages of Esper measure their wealth and status by the number of these creatures in their retinues.

Homunculi vaguely resemble small, "toy" versions of vedalken, which appears to make the vedalken uncomfortable around them. Whether humans intend a deeper symbolism in the homunculi’s appearance — as an homage to the wise and noble vedalken, or as a hint to some sinister origin of the creatures — is not known. Though the lives of homunculi aren't considered intrinsically valuable, humans keep them well protected, probably due to the labor and expense of their creation.
It isn't known for certain who or what creates the cantankerous, seemingly independent homunculi that can be found around Paliano . ( Jeering Homunculus )
The homunculi of Innistrad are based on the hunchbacked assistants of mad scientists or vampires in old horror movies ( Stitcher's Apprentice ).

The sentient homunculi of Kylem are the caretakers of Valor's Reach . Their most visible role is on the field acting as penalty mages; no foul during play escapes their watch. Due to their lack of mouths, Homunculi primarily use sign language to communicate. All adults on Kylem know sign language, so the homunculi can be readily understood. Zndrsplt uses a telepathic link to allow her cyclops friend Okaun to speak for her.

In Magic SpellSlingers , a homunculus announcer and 14-time champion of Valor's Reach named Vnwxt (often shortened as "Vin") speaks to both the player and the crowd. His communication may be telepathic but is never explained in detail. Through his success as the SpellSlingers emcee, Vin would go on to become the emcee of the second Ghirapur Grand Prix .
The names of Zndrsplt and Vnwxt suggest that, similar to Ravnican homunculi, Kylem's homunculi do not use vowels in their full names (although Vnwxt's nickname, Vin, does include a vowel).

The homunculi of Ravnica are less human-like, and more imp -like ( Doorkeeper , Frilled Oculus ). They can't speak but do communicate with sign language and in written form. Ravnican homunculi don't have vowels in their names.
